text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's schedule is... alright. The 
meeting with that fan about the reception.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm invited as a special guest performer. 
I have to make it the most exciting 
reception ever!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. ...Wait, huh? 
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet-san, what do I do?! The 
wedding might be ruined...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A 'bridesmaid'... If I recall, that's 
someone who supports the bride, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The friend who promised to do it 
had a sudden job transfer and won't be 
able to attend anymore...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I asked her to be my attendant and act as 
the witness for our civil ceremony. 
Finding a replacement now is practically 
impossible, I don't know what to do...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
............Um, the schedule and 
procedures for the day are already set, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If so, will you let me be your bridesmaid?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? E-Eeeeh?! You, Daiwa Scarlet-san?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I promise to memorize the procedures 
flawlessly. And of course, I won't slack 
off on my guest performance either.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's way too gracious! Having the 
person I look up to most act as my support 
staff is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in everything I do. Since I 
accepted this invitation, I want to 
deliver nothing less than the absolute 
best!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me help you make your 
shining moment perfect!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet-san...! ...Yes! Please!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should I do... Now that the 
moment's here, my heart is beating out of 
my chest...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine. I'm right here with you. 
—Now, let us proceed.

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
The bride will now enter, accompanied by 
her bridesmaid.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, her attendant is Daiwa Scarlet?! 
Isn't she the favorite Uma Musume of the 
bride and groom?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
The bridesmaid acts as the ceremony 
witness today, right? Vowing your love in 
front of your favorite idol is so 
enviable~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Now, I ask you both. Life is a race with 
an unseen finish line. There will be steep 
slopes, and there will be muddy tracks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even so, do you vow to encourage one 
another, support each other, and run 
together until the very end?

text_block_list.name: Bride and Groom
text_block_list.text: Yes, we do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As an Uma Musume who races upon the turf, 
I bear witness. This bride and groom will 
surely overcome any obstacle and seize a 
radiant future together.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us give a grand round of applause to 
the two who have just set off on their new 
journey!

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The reception is almost over. The 
performance was a huge hit too, I'm so 
glad it looks like everything's wrapping 
up safely...

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
And now, a letter of gratitude from the 
bride. Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, I wasn't told anything about 
this...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...There is someone special I wish to 
express my deepest gratitude to. Without 
this person, we would never have been able 
to welcome this extraordinary day.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet-san... You are our idol, and 
the greatest benefactor of our lives. 
Thank you, so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez, honestly...! Pulling a surprise like 
that is totally unfair...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I 
spotted Daiwa Scarlet reading a letter.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's from my fans! Believe it or not, they 
sent it all the way from their honeymoon 
destination.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You can really tell how blissfully happy 
they are just from reading it... Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet had stayed true to her pride 
of being number one. Her expression was 
full of pride, yet softened with deep 
tenderness.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Truly...! Both your vow ceremony words and 
your dance performance will be treasured 
memories for a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was all mine. Being able to 
help make your shining moment 
unforgettable made me so happy too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wish you both eternal happiness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the academy cafeteria, I 
noticed Daiwa Scarlet sipping coffee from 
a mug.
choice_data_list: Where did you get that mug?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This? It was a wedding favor gift. It's 
become my absolute favorite.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's a medal showing that I helped 
decorate the number one stage of their 
lives—fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet had stayed true to her pride 
of being number one. Her expression was 
full of pride, yet softened with deep 
tenderness.
